scripts.dev: npm run env:init && npm run db:up && npm run db:setup && npm run dev:apps
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run start:dev -w backend_service" "npm run dev -w web"
